## om10mi-mods { #om10mi-mods }

**Get it:** [v87](https://github.com/Meghnus/om10mi-mods/releases/tag/v87), 21 Nov 2026 · [Install guide](https://github.com/Meghnus/om10mi-mods/blob/46874155947715e0d54baabe2df5006376c8bbab/INSTALL.md)
{ .card-get }

Unofficial, for the E-M10 Mark I on firmware 1.4 only; tested on one body. No warranty; installing custom firmware is risky. The ART dial no longer reaches the stock art filters.
{ .release-warning }

- **Film looks** · Available. 18 looks in Picture Mode, the SCP menu, Live View and RAW Data Edit, including Portra 400, Kodachrome 64, Ektar 100 and Gold 200, each with its own icon since 87; Contrast, Sharpness, Highlight, Shadow and Gradation act on them.
- **Per-sector colour editor** · Available. Hue, Saturation and Lightness for 12 named colour sectors, also per bank in RAW Data Edit.
- **Per-look colour editor** · Available. Colour edits for each look on the Custom page (Picture Mode, right key).

[Full project details](../projects/om10mi-mods.md#for-em10) · [Ask or report issues](https://github.com/Meghnus/om10mi-mods/issues) · [Report your result](https://github.com/xulfr/om-firmware-atlas/issues/new?template=camera-report.yml&target=Olympus+OM-D+E-M10+%28Mark+I%29+%C2%B7+stock+firmware%3A+&package=om10mi-mods+%C2%B7+v87)
